FLUQON.QPON / INSTALL

Install fluqon.qpon.

Fluke on Coupon. A separate app window, one click from your desktop.

Open this page in Chrome to install the app.

In Chrome

  1. Choose the install icon at the right of the address bar.
  2. Confirm Install. The app opens in its own window using our separate f icon.

If the icon is missing, open Chrome’s three-dot menu, then Cast, save, and share → Install page as app.

On Android, use Chrome’s menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

Same feed. Less browser clutter.

No login, no extra tracking. You need an internet connection to check offers. Offline, the app shows a connection notice rather than old coupon pages.

The live feed only shows current checked offers. preview.fluq_ contains separate, unchecked examples. Installing the app does not change an offer’s status.
